name: Suzuki RM-Z250
engine: 249 cc liquid-cooled four-stroke single, carb then fuel injection
intro: Suzuki's 250 four-stroke motocross bike. Hour-based service, valves to check and no lights.

H: Four-stroke motocross engines need frequent valve checks and oil changes. Follow the hour-based schedule in the manual, not the calendar.

recallNote: No recalls found for these years when this course was written. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to be sure.
